cs.t: > Drop the Apple earbuds in the garbage and get TRN V80 in-ear-monitors for under $50. Awesome recommendation. I ordered these ($40 on Amazon) based on your comment and they are great. I have been using 5 year old $50 Sony earbuds which are good, but these TRNs are amazing. My only complaint is that they are pretty heavy so I'm not sure I could run in them. For my use that doesn't matter since I have BT earbuds for workouts. Thanks again!
cs.th: They Don’t Make Music Like They Used To
